description: Lossless editing JSON contract for kces.model.

boneNames.description: The ordered names paired with bone indices in the mesh and transform data.
boneNames.title: Bone name table
boneNames.x-meido-edit-guidance: Do not reorder or rename entries without rewriting all dependent weights and paths.
boneNames.x-meido-game-usage: Skinning and attachment code resolves weighted bones through this table.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: Parts.Model is a MessagePack indexed object with fixed version 1001, model and mesh file names, bone transforms, material names, morphs, skin-thickness data, and shadow flags.

PartsModelManager loads and deserializes the model, constructs the transform hierarchy, applies local transforms, loads the separate mesh, binds bones and materials, and forwards morph and skin-thickness data.

fileName.description: The logical .model file name stored in the record.
fileName.title: Model file name
fileName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use the deployed .model name with its expected extension and case convention.
fileName.x-meido-game-usage: The parts manager uses it as the model resource name.

id.description: The unsigned identifier used by parts resource lookup.
id.title: Model resource ID
id.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep it consistent with the target file-name/hash convention.
id.x-meido-game-usage: PartsModelManager registers and resolves model records by their resource identity.

materialFileName.title: Material resource names
materialFileName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep the number and order aligned with mesh submaterials and deploy the referenced .mate files.
materialFileName.x-meido-game-usage: PartsModelManager resolves these names through the material manager.

meshfileName.description: The separate mesh resource referenced by the model description, normally a .mmesh asset.
meshfileName.title: Mesh resource name
meshfileName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Ensure the referenced mesh exists in the same target catalog and keep the spelling exact.
meshfileName.x-meido-game-usage: The loader resolves this resource to obtain vertex, index, and skin data.

modelName.description: The exact transData[].name selected as the VirtualHierarchy that receives the SkinnedMeshRenderer.
modelName.title: Render-root transform selector
modelName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep it equal to exactly one transData[].name. It is not a display name; when renaming the selected transform, update modelName and every dependent bone/reference together.
modelName.x-meido-game-usage: PartsModelManager names the outer object from fileName, then compares every created transform name with modelName and dereferences the selected hierarchy without a null check.

morphs.description: Blend-shape records containing named vertex deltas and ranges.
morphs.title: Morph records
morphs.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve vertex indices and delta-array lengths; edit only with the companion mesh in view.
morphs.x-meido-game-usage: The model loader applies these records to facial or body deformation targets.

shadowModeFlags.title: Shadow mode
shadowModeFlags.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use only values supported by the target build and verify the resulting renderer mode.
shadowModeFlags.x-meido-game-usage: The renderer applies this value when configuring model shadow behavior.

version.description: The indexed MessagePack version, fixed at 1001 by the current Parts.Model constructor.
version.title: Model version

version.x-meido-game-usage: PartsUtility.Deserialize<Model> uses the versioned object while loading model metadata.
